translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Baabloone Kaatii Naabukadanas'oore omoodiide, bare gadiyaa afeedda asaappe pude barenttu katamaa katamaa, Yerusaalamenne Yihudaa simmeedda asatuu hawaappe kaalliyaawantta.
Unttunttu Zarubaabeela, Iyyaasa, Nahimiyaa, Saraaya, Ra'eelaaya, Marddikiyoosa, Bilishaana, Misppaara, Bigiwaaya, Rehuumanne Ba'aana. Omooduwaappe simmeedda Israa'eeliyaa asaa paydu hawaa.
Iyyaasunne Yoo'aaba naanaa gidiyaa Paahati-Moo'aaba yaratuu 2,812.
Hawanttu omooduwaappe simmeedda k'eesetuwaa: Iyyaasu yara gidiyaa Yadaaya yaratuu 973;
Hawanttu omooduwaappe simmeedda Leewatuwaa: Hodaawiyaa yara gidiyaa Iyyaasunne K'aadimi'eela yaratuu 74;
Penggiyaa naagiyaa Shaaluuma, As'eera, S'almmoona, Ak'k'uuba, Has'iis'anne Shobaaya yaratuu 139.
Geeshsha Golliyaan ootsiyaa k'oomatuwaa yaratuwaa: S'iiha yaratuwaa, Hasuufa yaratuwaa, S'abba'oota yaratuwaa,
K'eeroosa yaratuwaa, Si'aaha yaratuwaa, Padoona yaratuwaa,
Labaana yaratuwaa, Hagaaba yaratuwaa, Ak'k'uuba yaratuwaa,
Hagaaba yaratuwaa, Shamilaaya yaratuwaa, Hanaana yaratuwaa,
Giddeela yaratuwaa, Gahaara yaratuwaa, Ra'aaya yaratuwaa,
Raas'iina yaratuwaa, Nak'oda yaratuwaa, Gazzaama yaratuwaa,
Uuza yaratuwaa, Paaseeha yaratuwaa, Besaaya yaratuwaa,
Asinaa yaratuwaa, Me'uniima yaratuwaa, Nafisiima yaratuwaa,
Baak'ibuuk'a yaratuwaa, Hak'uufa yaratuwaa, Harihuura yaratuwaa,
Baas'iluuta yaratuwaa, Mahiida yaratuwaa, Harshsha yaratuwaa,
Bark'k'oosa yaratuwaa, Sisaara yaratuwaa, Temaaha yaratuwaa,
Solomone k'oomatuwaa yaratuwaa: Sos'aaya yaratuwaa, Hassofereeta yaratuwaa, Paruuda yaratuwaa,
Yaa'ila yaratuwaa, Dark'k'oona yaratuwaa, Giddeela yaratuwaa,
Shafaas'iyaa yaratuwaa, Has's'iila yaratuwaa, Pokereti-Has's'abayma yaratuwaanne Aama yaratuwaa.
Geeshsha Golliyaan ootsiyaa k'oomatuwaa yaratuunne Solomone k'oomatuwaa yaratuwaa paydu ubbaanna heezzu s'eetanne udduppun tammanne laa"uwaa.

Haratuukka k'ay Telmmelaaha, Teliharshsha, Karuuba, Adaananne Imeera giyaa katamatuwaappe Yerusaalame pude beeddino. Shin unttunttu; barenttu aawotuu Israa'eeliyaa sheeshsha gidiyaawaa erissanaw danddayibeykkino.
Hewanttu Dalaaya, S'oobbiyaanne Nak'oda yaratuwaa; unttunttu payduukka ubbaanna usuppun s'eetanne ishatamanne laa"uwaa.

K'eesetuwaappe Habaaya yaratuu, Hak'k'oos'a yaratuunne Barzzillaaya yaratuu simmeeddino. Hawe Barzzillaaya giyaawe Gala'aade biittaa asaa gidiyaa Barzzillaaya naatto akkiidde, bare bolluwaa suntsaan s'eesetteedda.

Hawanttu barenttu yeletaa s'ap'uwaa eranaw yeletaa mas'aafan koyeeddino, shin demmibeykkino. Hewaa diraw, unttunttu tunaadan paydettiide, k'eesetetsan ootsennaadaninne K'eese gidenaadan digetteeddino.
K'ay Uuriimiyaaninne Tumiimiyaan shaakki pirddiyaa k'eesii denddana gakkanaw, unttunttu geeshsha k'umaappe maanaw danddayennawaa Ayhudatuwaa mooddiyaawe unttuntta azazeedda.
Omooduwaappe Yihudaa biittaa simmeedda asaa paydu ubbaanna 42,360.
Hewaa bollakka k'ay 7,337 attuma k'oomatuunne mac'c'a k'oomatuunne 200 attumawaanne mac'c'a mazimuriyaa yes's'iyaawanttukka simmeeddino.

Unttunttu Yerusaalamen kase Med'ina Goda Gollii de'iyaa sa'aa gakkeedda wode, yaratuu kaappatuwaappe amareedawanttu Med'inaa Godaa Gollii kase bare sa'aan kees's'ettana mala, barenttu sheniyaan imotaa immeeddino.

Ittuu ittuu barew danddayiyaawaa keeshshaa keeshshaa ha S'oossaa Golliyaa oosoo immeedda; unttunttu ubbaanna 500 kiilo giraamiyaa dees'iyaa work'k'aa, 2,800 kiilo giraamiyaa dees'iyaa biraanne 100 k'eesatuwaa mayuwaa immeeddino.

Hewaappe guyyiyaan k'eesatuu, Leewatuunne asaappe amareedawanttu Yerusaalamen utteeddino; mazimuriyaa yes's'iyaawanttu, penggiyaa naagiyaawanttunne Geeshsha Golliyaan ootsiyaa k'oomatuu Yerusaalame yuushshuwaan de'iyaa katamatuwaan utteeddino; k'ay atteeda Israa'eeliyaa asatuu ubbay barenttu katamatuwaan katamatuwaan utteeddino.
